name: DINXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Twisted Electrons' BlastBeats OPL3 FM groovebox as a plugin: the published v7.1 firmware runs unmodified on a software model of its board (YMF262 via ymfm, 56 faders, 32 keys, LED matrix, card), so every mode, trick and sequencer quirk is the machine's own. 6 drum + 4 four-op synth voices, 64-step sequencer with p-locks, automation, probability, songs. Card state lives in the project. By L'Cronx; not made or endorsed by Twisted Electrons.
